description: The BROWNFIELD_ANSWER_SYSTEM prompt (Pass B, α.36) MUST enforce six rules so the reflexive pass calibrates correctly: (1) verbatim question copy, (2) conservative ambiguous=unanswered, (3) concrete source citations, (4) JSON-only output, (5) style/PM-judgement always unanswered, (6) empty-input graceful path. Validated against delgoosh#635 baseline (2026-05-15) where static analysis predicted 2/7 questions answered from brownfield (29% PM-friction reduction).
